title: Marvel crams every superhero ever into Avengers: Doomsday final trailer
gist: Marvel released the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday, the penultimate Phase Six film of the Multiverse Saga, featuring a sprawling ensemble across three universes with Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom. The film opens December 18, 2026 head-to-head with Dune: Part III, with Avengers: Secret Wars slated for December 17, 2027.

themes.theme: Marvel release slate and box-office competition

insights.claim: Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters on December 18, 2026, the same day as Dune: Part III, setting up a direct box-office clash.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: A same-day release of two tentpoles could split holiday box office for Disney and the Dune studio.
insights.quote: It will battle it out against Dune: Part III, which also releases that same day.

insights.claim: Avengers: Secret Wars is slated for December 17, 2027 and will conclude the Marvel Cinematic Universe's Phase Six and the Multiverse Saga.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Marks Marvel's next major tentpole catalyst a year out.

insights.claim: Avengers: Doomsday leans on a massive ensemble spanning the Avengers, Wakandans, Thunderbolts, Fantastic Four and original X-Men, with Robert Downey Jr. returning as Doctor Doom and Chris Evans returning as Steve Rogers.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Marvel is betting on nostalgia and star power to revive franchise momentum.

insights.claim: The reviewer is uncertain whether Avengers: Doomsday will measure up to Infinity War and Endgame but expects it to provide a spectacle.
insights.speaker: Jennifer Ouellette
insights.so_what: Signals tempered critical expectations for Marvel's comeback tentpole.
insights.quote: We don’t know if Doomsday will measure up to Infinity War and End Game, but it’s bound to provide a spectacle.
insights.locator: Verdict: We don’t know if Doomsday
